messages.subject: Re: Successfully assigned alignments : 0 (0,0%)
messages.body_plain:
Hi Yang

You are correct, that was the problem. For some reason I tried to map the reads to the DNA sequences of my protein library (prodigal output), however I should have mapped them to the contigs themselves.
It worked fine now!
Thanks for the help!

Best regards, Balázs

messages.subject: No --readShiftType and --readShiftSize in featureCounts 1.6.3
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

In the document SubreadUsersGuide.pdf, new options --readShiftType and --readShiftSize were listed. However, the options were not available in the version 1.6.3.

messages.subject: Re: No --readShiftType and --readShiftSize in featureCounts 1.6.3
messages.body_plain: Sorry about this. These options are currently available in the R version of the software (http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/Rsubread.html). And they will be supported in Subread version 1.6.4 which will be released very soon.
